declarations.text: Trust is not a feeling. It is a decision I make and a position I hold. I cling to God with an unshakeable grip and I do not let go no matter what I see around me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord... There was no one like him among all the kings of Judah.

declarations.text: Following God is not a fair-weather commitment. I hold fast. I do not stop. I do not drift, retreat, or compromise. My obedience is total and my pursuit is unrelenting.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He held fast to the Lord and did not stop following him.

declarations.text: I take every threat and every accusation of the enemy straight to God in prayer. I spread it all before Him. He sees it, He answers it, and He silences it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Hezekiah received the letter... went up to the temple of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord.

declarations.text: My roots go deep before my fruit appears. I invest in what is underground with God. What He establishes in the hidden places of my life rises and bears fruit above.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Once more a remnant... will take root below and bear fruit above.

declarations.text: God controls my timeline. What the enemy planned to cut short, God extends and redeems. My years are in His hands and His purpose for my life is not finished.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will add fifteen years to your life. And I will deliver you and this city.

declarations.text: I turn to God with my whole heart and my whole soul. I give Him no divided loyalty and no partial surrender. My pursuit of Him is total, anchored, and without reservation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Neither before nor after Josiah was there a king like him who turned to the Lord as he did.

declarations.text: I give freely to the work of God. What I release into His purpose returns multiplied. Generosity is my covenant posture.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the people rejoiced because they had given willingly, for with a whole heart they had offered freely to the Lord. David the king also rejoiced greatly.

declarations.text: Everything I have belongs to God. I hold nothing tightly. I am a steward of His abundance and I give with joy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? Everything comes from you, and we have given you only what comes from your hand.

declarations.text: God keeps covenant with those who love Him. I love Him. His faithfulness over my life is sealed and unshakeable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lord, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth. You who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

declarations.text: I give thanks to God, for His love endures forever. His mercy is not seasonal. It is eternal and it covers my life completely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

declarations.text: I seek the Lord and His strength. I seek His face continually. He is the source of every good thing in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.

declarations.text: I remember the wonders God has performed. I rehearse His miracles. His judgments and His faithfulness are the foundation I stand on.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced.

declarations.text: My humble heart turns God's hand toward mercy. I bow low and He lifts high. Humility is my strongest posture before Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord spoke to the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath. David saw that the Lord had answered him.

declarations.text: God's faithfulness stretches to a thousand generations. I am covered by the covenant He made with my fathers and I walk in its benefits today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations.

declarations.text: I exalt God's name above every name. His greatness is unsearchable and I spend my life exploring the depths of who He is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

declarations.text: I bring an offering of worship before God. I come before Him with joy. His courts are where I belong and I enter them with praise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Bring an offering and come before him; worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.

declarations.text: God multiplies what I surrender to Him. Nothing I release for His kingdom is wasted. His multiplication exceeds my imagination.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to David: In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men.

declarations.text: I am established in God's covenant promises. His word over my life is fixed. I build on it and nothing shakes me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As for you, be strong and do not give up, for your work will be rewarded.

declarations.text: I glorify God with everything I have. My wealth, my time, my gifts. All of it flows back to Him who gave it to me first.
declarations.bibleVerseText: David praised the Lord in the presence of the whole assembly, saying, 'Praise be to you, Lord, the God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.'

declarations.text: God assigns skilled people to the work of His house. I am one of them. He has equipped me and positioned me for this exact moment.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All these men were under the supervision of their father for the music of the temple of the Lord, with cymbals, lyres and harps, for the ministry at the house of God.

declarations.text: I worship God in spirit and in truth. My praise is not a performance. It is the overflow of a heart that knows who God is and what He has done.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yours, Lord, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the majesty and the splendor, for everything in heaven and earth is yours.

declarations.text: If I humble myself, pray, seek His face, and turn from my sin, God hears from heaven. He forgives me. He heals everything the enemy has touched.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.

declarations.text: God keeps covenant with those who love Him. I love Him. His lovingkindness is my shield and His promises are my inheritance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lord, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth. You who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

declarations.text: God's eyes are roaming the earth right now, searching for hearts fully devoted to Him. My heart is fully His. He finds me and He strengthens me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the eyes of the Lord range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him.

declarations.text: I inquire of God before I move. I do not trust my own plans alone. His counsel is the anchor of every decision I make.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, 'First seek the counsel of the Lord.'

declarations.text: Revival starts with me. I turn back to God. I remove every idol from my life. I restore His rightful place on the throne of my heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God. He removed the foreign altars and the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles.

declarations.text: I pray with my face toward heaven. God hears every word I speak. He is attentive to my prayer and His answer is on the way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.

declarations.text: No battle in my life belongs to me alone. It belongs to God. I position myself in faith and I watch His salvation unfold before me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He said: 'Listen, King Jehoshaphat and all who live in Judah and Jerusalem! This is what the Lord says to you: Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army. For the battle is not yours, but God's.'

declarations.text: I take my position. I stand firm. I hold still long enough to see what God will do. He is fighting and the victory is mine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will not have to fight this battle. Take up your positions; stand firm and see the deliverance the Lord will give you, Judah and Jerusalem.

declarations.text: God's name has a dwelling place and I carry it. His glory rests on those who seek Him. I am a house for His presence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have chosen and consecrated this temple so that my Name may be there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.

declarations.text: I prosper as I seek God. Seeking Him is not passive. It is relentless pursuit and it produces fruit that remains.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. As long as he sought the Lord, God gave him success.

declarations.text: I sanctify myself for the work God has called me to. I prepare my heart. I show up ready and He moves through me powerfully.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The priests and the Levites sanctified themselves and brought up the burnt offerings to the temple of the Lord.

declarations.text: Passover is my testimony. God delivers me with a mighty hand. I celebrate His redemption and I will not stop celebrating.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There was great joy in Jerusalem, for since the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel there had been nothing like this in Jerusalem.

declarations.text: I repair the altar of God in my life. I clear away the rubble. I restore what was broken and I return to genuine worship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They repaired the altar of the Lord that had been torn down.

declarations.text: Hezekiah prayed and God answered. I pray and God answers. My cry reaches the God who hears and He responds to me specifically.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord: 'Lord, the God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth.'

declarations.text: God is sovereign over every king, every nation, and every circumstance of my life. Nothing is outside His rule. I rest in His unshakeable authority.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, in order to fulfill the word of the Lord spoken by Jeremiah, the Lord moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia.

declarations.text: God's hand opens doors that no amount of networking can unlock. His favor over my life is my greatest asset.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And because the gracious hand of my God was on me, the king granted my requests.

declarations.text: I devote myself to the study and practice of God's Word. Mastery is rooted in devotion. Deep immersion in scripture commissions me for places raw skill cannot reach.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a teacher well versed in the Law of Moses, which the Lord, the God of Israel, had given.

declarations.text: God's favor rests on me because I look to Him. His grace covers everything I face when I keep my eyes fixed on God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him, but his great anger is against all who forsake him.

declarations.text: I fast and pray before I move. I seek God's direction before I take a single step. Humility in me precedes every blessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There, by the Ahava Canal, I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.

declarations.text: I petition God before I go. He answers my prayers. His protection covers every journey I take in faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and he answered our prayer.

declarations.text: I handle what God entrusts to me with integrity. I am a faithful steward. I am accountable for what He places in my hands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I weighed out to them the offering of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his advisers, his officials and all Israel present there had donated for the house of our God.

declarations.text: God restores what was lost in my life. The sight of what He rebuilds moves me to tears I cannot contain.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But many of the older priests and Levites and family heads, who had seen the former temple, wept aloud when they saw the foundation of this temple being laid, while many others shouted for joy.

declarations.text: God's restoration in my life is so overwhelming, joy and grief become the same thing. He moves me with a depth I cannot manufacture.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one could distinguish the sound of the shouts of joy from the sound of weeping, because the people made so much noise. And the sound was heard far away.

declarations.text: I finish what God started in me. Every opposition is proof I am building something worth stopping. I press through and complete the work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So the elders of the Jews continued to build and prosper under the preaching of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah, a descendant of Iddo. They finished building the temple according to the command of the God of Israel.

declarations.text: When God finishes a work in me, it is worth celebrating. I do not rush past the moment of dedication. I mark it with joy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the people of Israel the priests, the Levites and the rest of the exiles celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.

declarations.text: God changes hearts in high places to help me fulfill my purpose. I celebrate His work with everything I have.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For seven days they celebrated with joy the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because the Lord had filled them with joy by changing the attitude of the king of Assyria so that he assisted them in the work on the house of God, the God of Israel.

declarations.text: I devote myself first, then I teach. I cannot give what I have not received. I go deep in God's Word before I go wide in His mission.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the Lord, and to teaching its decrees and laws in Israel.

declarations.text: God's justice is final. Every wrong done against me is already seen by Him. He holds the last word over every injustice I have faced.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever does not obey the law of your God and the law of the king must surely be punished by death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.

declarations.text: I tremble at God's Word. I do not take scripture lightly. His Word demands a response, and I give it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of this unfaithfulness of the exiles.

declarations.text: God has not forgotten me. In the middle of every mess, He is preserving my future. His light already shines on what is ahead.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But now, for a brief moment, the Lord our God has been gracious in leaving us a remnant and giving us a firm place in his sanctuary, and so our God gives light to our eyes and a little relief in our bondage.

declarations.text: I make the covenant. I cut what dishonors God from my life. My future is shaped by the decisions I make today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all these women and their children, in accordance with the counsel of my lord and of those who fear the commands of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.

declarations.text: Obstacles do not stop God's work in me. They reveal how serious I am about finishing what He commissioned me to build.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But there are many people here and it is the rainy season; so we cannot stand outside. Besides, this matter cannot be taken care of in a day or two, because we have sinned greatly in this thing.

declarations.text: God moves the hearts of rulers to advance my purpose. No person in authority over my life is beyond His reach.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to make a proclamation.

declarations.text: The hand of God on my life is my real source of courage. I draw from that presence. I move forward anchored in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because the hand of the Lord my God was on me, I took courage.

declarations.text: The Word I plant in my heart today bears fruit I carry for the rest of my life. I am rooted in scripture and established in truth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the Lord, and to teaching its decrees and laws in Israel.

declarations.text: God puts it in the hearts of powerful people to help me. No favor I need is beyond His sovereign reach.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise be to the Lord, the God of our ancestors, who has put it into the king's heart to bring honor to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem.

declarations.text: God provides every resource I need to rebuild. When He calls me to restore, He supplies everything it takes to complete the work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then they gave money to the masons and carpenters, and gave food and drink and olive oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre, so that they would bring cedar logs by sea from Lebanon to Joppa.

declarations.text: When God lays a new foundation in my life, I shout. That first step of restoration is worth celebrating with everything in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And all the people gave a great shout of praise to the Lord, because the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid.

declarations.text: I separate myself from what pulls me away from God. Holiness is my choice. I make it today and every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Separate yourselves from the peoples around you and from your foreign wives.

declarations.text: God's love does not run out. His goodness does not expire. I am held in something eternal, unbreakable, and sealed by His enduring faithfulness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With praise and thanksgiving they sang to the Lord: 'He is good; his love toward Israel endures forever.'

declarations.text: I am meek before God and I inherit the earth. Meekness is not weakness. It is power under God's sovereign control, and I walk in it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.

declarations.text: I am persecuted for righteousness and the Kingdom of Heaven is mine. What the world uses to diminish me, God uses to promote me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

declarations.text: I repent and I step into the Kingdom of Heaven. The kingdom is at hand right now. I do not delay. I turn, I believe, and I enter.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.

declarations.text: I build my life on the words of Jesus. I am a wise builder. My foundation is rock. When the storm crashes against me, I stand unmoved.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

declarations.text: My yoke is easy and my burden is light because I take the yoke of Jesus. I come to Him weary and He gives me rest. I am not striving. I am carried.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

declarations.text: My faith moves mountains. I speak to impossibility with the authority of the kingdom and it obeys. Nothing is impossible to me when I believe.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move.

declarations.text: I treasure what is eternal. My heart is where my treasure is. I set my treasure in heaven and my heart stays locked on what cannot be taken from me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

declarations.text: I have an eye that is clear and my whole body is full of light. I fix my gaze on God and every part of me is illuminated and radiant.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are healthy, your whole body will be full of light.

declarations.text: I serve God alone. I do not divide my devotion between Him and wealth. God has all of me. I am undivided and fully His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be devoted to the one and despise the other.

declarations.text: I enter through the narrow gate. The path I walk is not the wide road of the crowd. I am called to a road that is rooted in truth and leads to life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the road that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.

declarations.text: I bear good fruit. I am known by what my life produces. My roots go deep into God and my branches yield what is true, lasting, and life-giving.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By their fruit you will recognize them. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?

declarations.text: I make disciples of all nations. I go in the name of Jesus. I baptize and I teach. I carry the Great Commission as my sealed mandate.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: When I pray, I go to my Father in secret and He rewards me openly. My prayer life is not a performance. It is a dwelling place where God meets me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

declarations.text: I do not store up treasure on earth where it decays and can be stolen. I invest in the eternal. I am established in a kingdom that cannot be shaken.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.

declarations.text: I do to others what I want done to me. This is the law and the prophets made simple. I walk as a kingdom citizen and treat others as God treats me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So in everything, do to others what you would have them do to you, for this sums up the Law and the Prophets.

declarations.text: I confess Jesus before men and He confesses me before my Father in heaven. I am not ashamed of Him. He is not ashamed of me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever acknowledges me before others, I will also acknowledge before my Father in heaven.

declarations.text: I take up my cross and follow Jesus. I lose my life for His sake and I find it. The self I surrender is replaced by something far greater.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.

declarations.text: God has given me authority over every demonic force. I am not fighting for victory. I am fighting from it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He said to them, 'I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven. I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy.'

declarations.text: Signs follow those who believe. Not those who hope. Not those who try. Those who believe. I believe. Signs follow me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues.

declarations.text: I am covered. What the enemy means to harm me cannot touch me. I walk in that protection now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all.

declarations.text: The gospel does not spread itself. I carry it. Every person I meet is a divine assignment.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He said to them, 'Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.'

declarations.text: I go and preach. God confirms His word with signs. My obedience activates His power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.

declarations.text: I have surrendered things for Jesus and for the gospel. God gives back a hundredfold. That is the kingdom covenant.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for me and the gospel will fail to receive a hundred times as much in this present age.

declarations.text: I cannot follow Jesus and keep my old life. I deny myself. I pick up the cross. I follow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.

declarations.text: I surrender my life to Jesus and find it. I do not cling to what I was. I am fully His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.

declarations.text: I will not trade my soul for the world. Nothing I could gain compares to what I already carry in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul? Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?

declarations.text: I am unashamed of Jesus and His words. I speak boldly in this generation. His glory comes to those who stand firm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father's glory with the holy angels.

declarations.text: My path to greatness runs through service. Not position. Not title. I am the servant of all.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Anyone who wants to be first must be the very last, and the servant of all.

declarations.text: How I treat the overlooked is how I treat Jesus. I do not skip the small ones. Every person I welcome in His name, I welcome Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me does not welcome me but the one who sent me.

declarations.text: Whatever holds me back from God is not worth keeping. I cut it off. Freedom is worth the cost.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life maimed than with two hands to go into hell.

declarations.text: I welcome the fire of God. It burns away what is false and refines what remains. I do not run from the process.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone will be salted with fire. Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again?

declarations.text: I carry salt. I preserve truth wherever I go. I am an instrument of peace in every room I enter.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with each other.

declarations.text: I am sent to heal the sick. I anoint and pray with boldness. The power of Jesus works through surrendered hands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.

declarations.text: The kingdom of God is within me. I do not wait for it to arrive. I release it wherever I go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The kingdom of God is in your midst.

declarations.text: I did not come to be served. I came to serve. My life is poured out as an offering, just as Jesus gave His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.

declarations.text: Old patterns cannot contain what God is pouring into my life. I am made new. I receive the new wine He is releasing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins.

declarations.text: What looks impossible to me is ordinary to God. All things are possible with Him. I stop limiting Him with my logic.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God.

declarations.text: Jesus spoke to the storm. Not around it. Not about it. To it. I speak to my storms with the same authority He gave me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.

declarations.text: God blesses me beyond what I can measure. His favor overflows. I am ready to contain it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear!

declarations.text: God's mercy does not stop with me. It runs through me into my children. I fear God and pass it on.
declarations.bibleVerseText: His mercy extends to those who fear him, from generation to generation.

declarations.text: I am hungry for God and He fills me with good things. I stay hungry. He keeps filling.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He has filled the hungry with good things but has sent the rich away empty.

declarations.text: Salvation does not stop with me. It moves through my whole house. I believe for everyone under my roof.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus said to him, 'Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.'

declarations.text: Jesus came to find the lost. Now I go. I am His commissioned agent. I am the plan.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.

declarations.text: Jesus has authority to forgive ALL my sin. Not some. All. I walk in that freedom today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.

declarations.text: I am anointed. Not for comfort. For mission. The Spirit of the Lord rests on me to proclaim good news to the poor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor.

declarations.text: I walk in the power of the Spirit. Everything I do is Spirit-fueled. I am not operating in my own strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole countryside.

declarations.text: This is my year of favor. Not next year. Not when I get it all together. The year of the Lord's favor is now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To proclaim the year of the Lord's favor.

declarations.text: God's word is not future tense for me. It is fulfilled today. In my hearing. Right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He began by saying to them, 'Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.'

declarations.text: When people reject me for Jesus, heaven takes notice. My reward is great. I do not quit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.

declarations.text: I rejoice and leap for joy when I am persecuted for Christ. My reward in heaven is great and I fix my eyes on it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven.

declarations.text: I give without expecting anything back. That is the kingdom economy. My reward comes from God, not people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great.

declarations.text: No word from God fails. Not one. What He has promised over my life is still on the way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For no word from God will ever fail.

declarations.text: The power of the Most High overshadows me. I am not exposed. I am covered, sealed, and dwelling under His presence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you.

declarations.text: My soul glorifies the Lord and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior. Not because life is easy. Because God is great.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My soul glorifies the Lord and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior.

declarations.text: The Mighty One has done great things for me. His name is holy. I declare it openly and I do not stay silent.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Mighty One has done great things for me holy is his name.

declarations.text: I believe and the promise activates. I do not wait for proof to believe. I believe first and the fulfillment follows.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!

declarations.text: I give and it comes back. Pressed down. Shaken together. Running over. I go first and God multiplies it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap.

declarations.text: God has given me authority over ALL the power of the enemy. I use it. Nothing can harm me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.

declarations.text: My name is written in heaven. That is worth more than any title on earth. I rejoice in that alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

declarations.text: The kingdom of God is within me right now. I am not waiting for it to arrive. I release it wherever I go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The kingdom of God is in your midst.

declarations.text: I am faithful with little and trusted with much. I do not despise small assignments. Every faithful step builds something eternal.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever is faithful in very little is also faithful in much.

declarations.text: My Father is glorified when I bear much fruit. Not a little. Much. I am rooted in Christ and I produce.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This is to my Father's glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

declarations.text: My Father is pleased to give me the kingdom. I am not afraid. The kingdom is mine and I walk in it boldly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.

declarations.text: My new birth is not from man. It is from God. That changes everything about who I am.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband's will, but born of God.

declarations.text: Jesus came full of grace and truth. I receive both. Not one without the other.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.

declarations.text: God's grace does not run out. I receive grace on top of grace. His supply is inexhaustible.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

declarations.text: True worship is not performance. I worship the Father in Spirit and truth. Anything less is just noise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth.

declarations.text: Doing God's will feeds me at a level food never can. I get full on obedience.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to them, 'I have food to eat that you know nothing about.' Then his disciples said to each other, 'Could someone have brought him food?' 'My food,' said Jesus, 'is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.'

declarations.text: My deepest hunger is for purpose, not pleasure. I do God's will. That is where I get fed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.

declarations.text: I have heard. I have believed. I have crossed from death to life. No condemnation stands over me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.

declarations.text: Jesus is the only thing that truly satisfies me. Everything else leaves me empty. I come to Him and I am filled.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Jesus declared, 'I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.'

declarations.text: I follow Jesus and darkness cannot hold me. I do not navigate in the dark. I walk in the light of life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, 'I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.'

declarations.text: Jesus said I AM before time began. He was there then. He is here now. He is enough.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, Jesus answered, before Abraham was born, I am!

declarations.text: Jesus is the only door to abundant life. I go through Him. There is no other way in.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore Jesus said again, 'Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.'

declarations.text: Jesus laid down His life for me. I was worth dying for. I refuse to live like I am worthless.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

declarations.text: Death does not get the final word over me. Jesus is the resurrection. I believe it and I am anchored in it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.'

declarations.text: I ask in Jesus' name. Not my own name. His. And I watch God move on my behalf.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

declarations.text: The Holy Spirit teaches me all things. I am never without wisdom. I ask and He answers.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things.

declarations.text: I stay connected to Jesus and fruit comes naturally. I am a branch rooted in the vine, established in His life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit.

declarations.text: Jesus gave me His joy. Not temporary happiness. Complete, lasting joy. I walk in it every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.

declarations.text: Jesus calls me friend, not servant. Friends know things servants do not. He trusts me with His heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master's business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

declarations.text: Trouble is guaranteed. But Jesus already conquered it. I fight from a position of victory, not toward one.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.

declarations.text: God loved me enough to give His Son. That is not small love. I receive it fully and I do not take it lightly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

declarations.text: My spirit was born from God's Spirit. I am not just flesh. I carry eternal origin in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.

declarations.text: I hold to Jesus' teaching. I know the truth. The truth has set me free and I walk in that freedom now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus said, 'If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples. Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.'

declarations.text: Jesus came so I could have life in full. Not half. Not survival. Full and overflowing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.

declarations.text: I am not a stagnant pond. I am a river. Living water flows through me and reaches others.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.

declarations.text: I believe and I do the works Jesus did. Even greater ones. I stop settling for less than His full commission over my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things.

declarations.text: I bring glory to the Father by bearing fruit that lasts. My life is a testimony of His sovereign power at work in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This is to my Father's glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

declarations.text: The Spirit guides me into all truth. I am not left to reason my way through life alone. He leads me and I follow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth.

declarations.text: I remain in Jesus and He remains in me. That is where my fruitfulness comes from. That is where my life is rooted.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Remain in me, as I also remain in you. No branch can bear fruit by itself; it must remain in the vine.

declarations.text: Jesus prayed that I would carry His full joy within me. That joy is not circumstantial. It is a dwelling gift from Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.

declarations.text: I am chosen and commissioned by Jesus. I did not choose Him first. He chose me and appointed me to bear lasting fruit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit, fruit that will last.

declarations.text: Jesus has sent me into the world just as the Father sent Him. I carry a divine commission. I go with His authority.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Again Jesus said, 'Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.'

declarations.text: I did not earn my righteousness. God gave it freely. I stop trying to pay for what is already purchased.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: My suffering is not a detour. It is the road. Perseverance is forged through pressure, not around it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance.

declarations.text: God's love is already inside me. The Spirit placed it there. I do not search for it. I release it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And hope does not put us to shame, because God's love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: Where sin increased, grace surged higher. My worst moment did not outrun God's grace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But where sin increased, grace increased all the more.

declarations.text: Sin is dead to me. I am alive to God. I count it as true and I live like it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: Sin is not my master. Grace is my new address. I no longer live under the old rules.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.

declarations.text: I am set free from sin and I belong to God. That is not bondage. That is where I thrive.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves of God, the benefit you reap leads to holiness, and the result is eternal life.

declarations.text: No condemnation. None. Zero. I refuse to carry what God has already removed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: When I do not know what to pray, the Spirit prays for me. I am never alone in the room.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us through wordless groans.

declarations.text: Jesus is at God's right hand right now, speaking on my behalf. I have the greatest advocate that exists.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who then is the one who condemns? No one. Christ Jesus who died more than that, who was raised to life is at the right hand of God and is also interceding for us.

declarations.text: God knew me before I was born. He destined me to bear the image of Jesus. That is still the plan.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.

declarations.text: If God is for me, it does not matter who stands against me. I have already done the math.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

declarations.text: God gave me His Son. He will not withhold anything else. What He did then covers everything I need now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?

declarations.text: My feet are beautiful. Not because of how they look. Because they carry the good news of the gospel.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!

declarations.text: I refuse to be pressed into the mold of this world. God is renewing my mind and transforming my life from the inside out.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

declarations.text: I am not ashamed of the gospel. It is the power of God that saves every person who believes. I carry that power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes.

declarations.text: Faith in Jesus gives me peace with God. Not peace after I try harder. Peace now, through Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: All things work for my good. Not some things. All things. Even the painful ones. God is sovereign over every chapter.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

declarations.text: I am not just surviving. I am more than a conqueror. That is who God declares me to be.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

declarations.text: Nothing in all creation can sever me from God's love. Not death. Not failure. Not darkness. Nothing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers, neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

declarations.text: I offer my body to God as a living sacrifice. Not my leftover time. My life. All of it. This is my worship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice.

declarations.text: My mind is being renewed by the Spirit of God. I think differently because I belong to a different kingdom. My thoughts align with what God says is true.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who live according to the flesh have their minds set on what the flesh desires; but those who live in accordance with the Spirit have their minds set on what the Spirit desires.

declarations.text: Faith rises in me when I hear the Word of Christ. I keep listening. My faith is built on what God says.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

declarations.text: I call on the name of Jesus and I am saved. Not maybe. Not possibly. Every single person who calls is saved. I am one of them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For, 'Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.'

declarations.text: I am called to be holy. I am set apart by God and sanctified in Christ Jesus. This is my identity and my standing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be his holy people.

declarations.text: I do not lack any spiritual gift. God has fully equipped me as I eagerly await the return of Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.

declarations.text: God keeps me firm to the end. I am blameless before Him. His faithfulness holds me and I cannot be shaken.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He will also keep you firm to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: God is faithful and He calls me into fellowship with His Son. I am anchored in that calling. Nothing breaks this bond.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is faithful, who has called you into fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

declarations.text: The message of the cross is the power of God in me. I am not perishing. I am saved and I carry resurrection power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

declarations.text: God's so-called foolishness is wiser than every human strategy. I trust His ways above my own understanding.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the foolishness of God is wiser than human wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than human strength.

declarations.text: God chose me. Not because I was the most qualified. Because His choosing makes me qualified. I am His chosen vessel.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

declarations.text: Christ is my wisdom, my righteousness, my holiness, and my redemption. He is my complete sufficiency. I am established in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is because of him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God, that is, our righteousness, holiness and redemption.

declarations.text: I have received the Spirit of God. He reveals to me what God has freely given me. I walk in the fullness of His gifts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What we have received is not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may understand what God has freely given us.

declarations.text: I have the mind of Christ. I reason with His wisdom and perceive with His perspective. My mind is renewed and radiant.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But we have the mind of Christ.

declarations.text: I am God's temple and His Spirit dwells in me. I am not an empty shell. I am a holy dwelling place of the Most High.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Don't you know that you yourselves are God's temple and that God's Spirit dwells in your midst?

declarations.text: I belong to Christ and Christ belongs to God. My identity is rooted in an unbreakable chain of belonging.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And you are of Christ, and Christ is of God.

declarations.text: The kingdom of God is not talk. It is power. I do not just speak the faith. I demonstrate it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.

declarations.text: I am washed. I am sanctified. I am justified in the name of Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of God. I am clean.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.

declarations.text: I am united with the Lord and I am one spirit with Him. His life flows through me. I am inseparably joined to Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But whoever is united with the Lord is one with him in spirit.

declarations.text: I run my race with purpose. I press toward the prize. I do not drift. I am focused and I finish what God started in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.

declarations.text: By the grace of God I am what I am. His grace toward me is not wasted. I work with all that He has deposited in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect.

declarations.text: I am a new creation. The old has gone. The new is here. I do not drag yesterday into today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

declarations.text: I carry the death of Jesus in my body so that His life is displayed through me. His resurrection power lives in my flesh.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

declarations.text: I do not lose heart. My light and momentary troubles are producing for me an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

declarations.text: I am God's co-worker. He calls me to holiness. I purify myself and complete sanctification in the fear of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we have these promises, dear friends, let us purify ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, perfecting holiness out of reverence for God.

declarations.text: Godly grief produces repentance in me. I do not run from conviction. I let it do its transforming work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

declarations.text: I give generously and cheerfully. God loves a cheerful giver and I am one. My generosity is an act of worship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

declarations.text: God supplies seed for me to sow and multiplies what I plant. Every act of generosity I release returns in abundance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will also supply and increase your store of seed and will enlarge the harvest of your righteousness.

declarations.text: I do not wage war with worldly weapons. My weapons carry divine power to demolish every stronghold.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

declarations.text: I take every thought captive and make it obedient to Christ. My mind is not a battleground that the enemy controls.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We demolish arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

declarations.text: I boast in the Lord alone. My strength is not my own. My credibility comes from what God has built in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But, 'Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord.' For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

declarations.text: His grace is sufficient for me. His power is made perfect in my weakness. I glory in my weakness so Christ's power rests on me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

declarations.text: When I am weak, then I am strong. I have learned this truth and I stand on it without apology.
declarations.bibleVerseText: That is why, for Christ's sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

declarations.text: I examine myself. I test whether I am in the faith. Christ is in me and I walk in that assurance daily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Christ Jesus is in you?

declarations.text: The grace of Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Spirit are mine. I live inside this holy communion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

declarations.text: I walk by faith, not by sight. What I cannot see with my eyes, I trust with my whole heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we live by faith, not by sight.

declarations.text: I am an ambassador for Christ. God makes His appeal through me. I carry His word with authority and conviction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We are therefore Christ's ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us. We implore you on Christ's behalf: Be reconciled to God.

declarations.text: Christ became sin so I could become the righteousness of God. I stand before the Father fully righteous, fully covered, fully His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

declarations.text: I cannot please people and serve God at the same time. I choose God. His approval is the only one that lasts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

declarations.text: My gospel is not man-made. It came by revelation from Jesus Christ. No one can talk me out of what God has shown me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that the gospel I preached is not of human origin. I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: I do not live by what I see. I live by faith in the Son of God. That is a different level entirely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

declarations.text: The law led me to Christ. Christ is here now. I am no longer under a guardian. I am justified by faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So the law was our guardian until Christ came that we might be justified by faith.

declarations.text: Faith has come and I am no longer under a guardian. I am not a student waiting for approval. I am a son of the living God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now that this faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.

declarations.text: Faith in Jesus Christ makes me a child of God. Not good behavior. Not religious effort. Faith alone establishes my identity.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So in Christ Jesus you are all children of God through faith.

declarations.text: I am clothed with Christ. Not my past. Not my failures. Christ covers me and Christ is what others encounter in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

declarations.text: In Christ, every dividing wall is gone. I belong to one family, one Father, and one eternal inheritance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I belong to Christ, which makes me Abraham's heir. The promise is mine. I stop living like an outsider to my own inheritance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

declarations.text: God's timing is sovereign and perfect. He sent Jesus at exactly the right moment to redeem me and seal my adoption.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law, to redeem those under the law, that we might receive adoption to sonship.

declarations.text: God has sent the Spirit of His Son into my heart. I cry Abba. That is son language. Not servant language. I know who I am.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because you are his sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, 'Abba, Father.'

declarations.text: I am no longer a slave. I am God's child and a fully vested heir. Sons and slaves do not operate the same way. I am a son.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So you are no longer a slave, but God's child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

declarations.text: My real home is the Jerusalem above, which is free. I am born free. No chain of law or shame can reclaim what Christ has liberated.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.

declarations.text: I am a child of promise. Not an accident. Not a plan B. I am born of the Spirit, rooted in the covenant of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now you, brothers and sisters, like Isaac, are children of promise.

declarations.text: The Spirit leads me and the law has no jurisdiction over me. I follow the Spirit and walk in liberty every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

declarations.text: I live by the Spirit, so I keep in step with the Spirit. I do not fall behind. I do not run ahead. I stay anchored and close.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.

declarations.text: I bear the marks of Jesus. That reality silences every accusation and settles every question. I am His and He is mine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: From now on, let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.

declarations.text: I seize every opportunity to do good. I do not wait for a better moment. The opportunity in front of me is the one God ordained.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.

declarations.text: I do not quit doing good. The harvest is real and it is coming. I hold my ground and reap at the proper time.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

declarations.text: I sow with intention because I know I reap what I sow. God is not mocked. I plant seeds of the Spirit and I harvest eternal life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows.

declarations.text: Christ has set me free for freedom. I stand firm in that liberty. No yoke of slavery reclaims what Christ has redeemed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

declarations.text: I walk by the Spirit daily. The flesh loses its grip when the Spirit leads. I stay sensitive, yielded, and free from fleshly control.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

declarations.text: The fruit of the Spirit grows in me as I stay connected to the Vine. Love, joy, peace, and faithfulness are my living reality.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

declarations.text: I have been crucified with Christ. My old self is gone. Christ now lives in me, and I yield fully to His life within.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.

declarations.text: I sow to the Spirit and I reap eternal life. Every choice I make is a seed. I choose wisely and I reap abundantly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever sows to please their flesh will reap destruction; whoever sows to please the Spirit will reap eternal life.

declarations.text: God calls me to holiness. Not to conform to the world but to be set apart. I walk in that calling with conviction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.

declarations.text: The Lord Himself establishes and guards my heart. He is my shield against the evil one. I am protected by His faithfulness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.

declarations.text: I am sober and self-controlled, clothed in faith and love as a breastplate. My helmet is the hope of salvation. I am armored for this day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

declarations.text: God is faithful. He calls me and He completes what He starts in me. My transformation is not my project. It is His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

declarations.text: I encourage others and build them up. This is how I walk worthy of my calling. My words carry life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

declarations.text: God considers me worthy of His calling. He fulfills every good purpose and every act of faith in me by His power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With this in mind, we constantly pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling, and that by his power he may bring to fruition your every desire for goodness and your every deed prompted by faith.

declarations.text: The name of Jesus is glorified in me and I am glorified in Him. This is the grace of my God at work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We pray this so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: God gives me eternal encouragement and good hope by His grace. My hope is not fragile. It is established and unshakeable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope.

declarations.text: God chose me from the beginning for salvation through the sanctifying work of the Spirit. I am called and I am sealed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits to be saved through the sanctifying work of the Spirit.

declarations.text: The Lord of peace Himself gives me peace at all times and in every situation. He is present with me. That settles everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

declarations.text: My own understanding has limits. God's does not. I trust Him with my whole heart and refuse to lean on what I think I know.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

declarations.text: I submit every area of my life to God. I do not just make plans and ask Him to bless them. I yield my ways to Him and He makes my paths straight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

declarations.text: Silver can be lost. Gold can be stolen. Wisdom builds wealth no one can take from me. I seek it above everything else.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding, for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

declarations.text: I make my plans, but God establishes my steps. I stop wrestling against His direction and let Him order my path.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

declarations.text: I guard my heart above all else. What I allow into it shapes everything that flows out of my life. I am intentional and discerning at the gate.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

declarations.text: My path does not stay dim. I walk in righteousness and it grows brighter with every step. I am moving toward the full light of day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

declarations.text: My plans without God are just wishes. I commit my work to Him and He causes my purposes to stand. I am established by His hand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

declarations.text: My words carry the power to defuse or ignite. I choose a gentle answer. That is not weakness. It is the wisdom of the discerning.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

declarations.text: I honor God and He adds length to my days. The fear of the Lord is not a burden. It is the anchor that extends and protects my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The fear of the Lord adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

declarations.text: Nothing I could ever desire compares to wisdom. Not money. Not status. Not comfort. I seek wisdom first and find more than I could have imagined.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

declarations.text: I am a person of wise lips. Knowledge flows from my mouth because wisdom is rooted in my heart. What I speak reflects what I treasure.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools are not upright.

declarations.text: I surround myself with people who sharpen me. Iron sharpens iron. My circle is intentional and I am stronger because of it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

declarations.text: I hold my plans loosely before God. Many are the plans in my heart, but it is the Lord's sovereign purpose that prevails. I align with His will and move.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Many are the plans in a person's heart, but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails.

declarations.text: My reputation outlasts my bank account. I build a good name on purpose. It is worth more than silver or gold and it opens doors wealth cannot.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.

declarations.text: I bring diligent hands to my work. Lazy hands produce poverty. I am not lazy. I am disciplined, focused, and my diligence produces increase.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lazy hands make for poverty, but diligent hands bring wealth.

declarations.text: The blessing of God rests on my life and brings wealth without painful striving. I stop grinding in my own strength and walk in His blessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: My words carry the power of life and death. I speak life every single day. I eat the fruit of what I say and I choose words that build.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

declarations.text: I pursue noble character. It is a crown to those closest to me. I build my home up with wisdom, integrity, and strength of spirit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A wife of noble character is her husband's crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

declarations.text: I am clothed with strength and dignity. I can laugh at the days to come. Fear has no power over me because I am rooted in God's wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

declarations.text: I live with such integrity and love that my family rises up and calls me blessed. My life is my greatest testimony. I build it well.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her.

declarations.text: I speak words seasoned with wisdom. My lips are a wellspring of life to those who hear me. I open my mouth with instruction and my tongue teaches what is good.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

declarations.text: I walk in integrity and righteousness guards me. My character is not ornamental. It is a shield. I am protected by the way I live.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Righteousness guards the person of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

declarations.text: I build my life with wisdom and establish it through understanding. Knowledge fills every room of what I am constructing. I do not build a great life by accident.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established; through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

declarations.text: I train my children in the way they should go. What I plant in them today will take root and hold for decades. I invest in them with purpose and intentionality.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.

declarations.text: I walk in humility. Pride brings destruction and a haughty spirit precedes a fall. I stay low, stay teachable, and stay standing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall. Better to be lowly in spirit along with the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.
